_comment: Controlled vocabulary for resolution-step extraction. The LLM must map every extracted step to one action + one object, and optionally one system. Unknown values are coerced to 'other' during validation. Edit this file to tune granularity, then re-run extract.py on a small --sample to check the mapping still lands well.

phases.diagnose: Finding out what is wrong. No system state changes.
phases.change: Actually changing system state. The resolution itself.
phases.coordinate: Talking to people: customer, colleagues, vendors.

investigate.desc: Checked logs, config, portal, monitoring; looked into cause

reproduce.desc: Attempted to reproduce or tested to confirm the fault

verify.desc: Tested after a change to confirm it works

monitor.desc: Left running / watched / waited to see if it recurs

triage.desc: Reviewed a security/monitoring alert or report and dispositioned it - benign, false-positive, no incident, no credentials found - with no config change

reset.desc: Reset a credential, MFA method, or device to a known state

create.desc: Created a new object (account, mailbox, group, record, rule)

grant.desc: Granted access, permission, membership, or a license

revoke.desc: Removed access, permission, membership, or a license

install.desc: Installed software, driver, agent, or physical hardware

configure.desc: Changed a setting, policy, rule, or profile

update.desc: Applied a patch, firmware, or version upgrade

restart.desc: Rebooted or restarted a device, server, service, or session

migrate.desc: Moved data, mailbox, or workload between systems/tenants

restore.desc: Restored data or a system from backup

run_backup.desc: Manually triggered or re-ran a backup job

clean_up.desc: Freed disk space, cleared cache, purged profile/VSS

block.desc: Blocked a sender, domain, IP, or account

unblock.desc: Unblocked/released a sender, domain, IP, or account

sync.desc: Forced a directory or data synchronisation

renew.desc: Renewed a certificate, license, domain, or subscription (distinct from a patch/version update)

add_exception.desc: Created an allow-list / exclusion / whitelist entry so an alert or block no longer fires

contact_customer.desc: Called, emailed, or ran a remote session with the customer

inform_customer.desc: Sent credentials, instructions, or a status update out

escalate_internal.desc: Handed off to a colleague, engineer, or internal team

escalate_vendor.desc: Raised with a supplier or third party

await_response.desc: Explicitly waiting on customer or third party

conduct_training.desc: Delivered or completed security-awareness training or a workshop (KnowBe4, Phished)

document.desc: Wrote up notes, updated documentation or the CMDB

order.desc: Requested a quote, purchase, or extra license

schedule.desc: Planned the work for a later date/window

no_action.desc: Closed with no technical work: duplicate, self-resolved, out of scope

resolve_unspecified.desc: Notes state the ticket was resolved but give NO detail about what was done (e.g. 'is opgelost', 'geregeld', 'doorgevoerd'). A coverage marker, not a process step - aggregate.py excludes it from pattern/variance metrics

other.desc: A real action that fits nothing above
